svg.title: Smart Home for AgentBuff: data model
svg.desc: pengguna (owner): One row per AgentBuff owner, keyed by the pairwise subject, with language, time zone and theme. sesi (session): Web sessions stored only as the sha256 of the cookie value, with idle and absolute expiry and revocation. status_hak (entitlement): Last answer from AgentBuff on whether the owner may use the app, with retry and failure counters. token_mcp (MCP token): Per-owner bearer tokens stored as sha256 hashes with a short prefix, source (manual or automatic), expiry and last use. jti_terpakai (used assertion): IDs of AgentBuff assertions already used, so an auto-connect assertion cannot be replayed. sambungan_tuya (Tuya connection): One per owner: the encrypted key, its masked form, region, status, cached homes and rooms, and WebSocket time. perangkat (device): Mirror of each Tuya device per owner with room, category, online state, properties, model, sensitive override and paired IR code. suasana (scene): Named list of device commands with icon, colour and last use, owned by one owner. jadwal (schedule): One-time, daily or weekly schedule with a friendly command or scene target, next run, last result and who made it. otomasi (automation): Trigger on a device change, up to ten actions, optional time window, cooldown and last run. foto_kamera (camera photo): Photo or clip copied from Tuya's cloud for 7 days, opened through a random link, tagged with its source. aktivitas (activity): Who asked for what: source, kind, summary, device, success or error, kept for 90 days.
svg.text: Data model
The main entities and how they relate.
pengguna (owner)
One row per AgentBuff owner, keyed by the
pairwise subject, with language, time zone and
theme.
sesi (session)
Web sessions stored only as the sha256 of the
cookie value, with idle and absolute expiry and
revocation.
status_hak (entitlement)
Last answer from AgentBuff on whether the
owner may use the app, with retry and failure
counters.
token_mcp (MCP token)
Per-owner bearer tokens stored as sha256
hashes with a short prefix, source (manual or
automatic), expiry and last use.
jti_terpakai (used assertion)
IDs of AgentBuff assertions already used, so an
auto-connect assertion cannot be replayed.
sambungan_tuya (Tuya connection)
One per owner: the encrypted key, its masked
form, region, status, cached homes and rooms,
and WebSocket time.
perangkat (device)
Mirror of each Tuya device per owner with room,
category, online state, properties, model,
sensitive override and paired IR code.
suasana (scene)
Named list of device commands with icon, colour
and last use, owned by one owner.
jadwal (schedule)
One-time, daily or weekly schedule with a
friendly command or scene target, next run, last
result and who made it.
otomasi (automation)
Trigger on a device change, up to ten actions,
optional time window, cooldown and last run.
foto_kamera (camera photo)
Photo or clip copied from Tuya's cloud for 7
days, opened through a random link, tagged with
its source.
aktivitas (activity)
Who asked for what: source, kind, summary,
device, success or error, kept for 90 days.
